description: Email an ISSUED invoice or quote to the user's customer — as a PDF and, where possible, as an e-invoice. This goes to a third party and cannot be taken back: ask the user before calling this. Without to, subject and message it goes out as Invoice suggests; pass them only if the user wants something else. Drafts cannot be sent: issue_invoice first.

message.description: Another email text, complete, in the recipient's language.

to.description: Another recipient address — only if the user names one.

name: send_invoice
title: Send invoice by email
